slides.say: Controlled or uncontrolled. These words describe who drives a component’s important information.
A panel with its own is active state is uncontrolled: the parent cannot influence it. A panel driven by props is controlled by its parent.

slides.text: Uncontrolled: easy to drop in, hard to coordinate. Controlled: flexible, but the parent must configure it.
slides.say: Uncontrolled components are easy to use, but hard to coordinate. Controlled ones are maximally flexible, but the parent must configure them fully.

slides.text: Not strict terms. Most components mix props and state.
slides.say: These are not strict technical terms. Most components mix both. You can always refactor later.
